tagline.zh: 浏览器里的 AI 编程工作台
tagline.en: AI coding workspace in the browser

summary.zh: 多文件管理、上下文问答、即时预览的一体化开发界面。
summary.en: Unified dev surface with multi-file editing, contextual AI chat, and instant preview.

description.zh: 这个项目是我对 AI 原生开发体验的第一次完整实现。重点是减少上下文切换，让问题讨论、代码修改和结果验证在一个界面完成。
description.en: This project is my first complete take on an AI-native dev experience, minimizing context switches between discussion, code changes, and validation.

design.zh: 暗色玻璃态工作台布局：左侧文件结构，中间编辑器，右侧 AI 互动面板，强调信息密度与专注感。
design.en: Dark glassmorphism workbench layout: file tree left, editor center, AI pane right, optimized for focus and information density.

architecture.zh: 前端单页应用 + 本地状态层 + 预览渲染沙箱，核心流程围绕「输入-生成-验证」。
architecture.en: Single-page frontend + local state layer + sandboxed preview renderer with an input-generate-validate loop.

tagline.zh: 图像提示词调试与模板平台
tagline.en: Prompt engineering playground for image models

summary.zh: 聚焦提示词结构化、参数复用和跨模型迁移。
summary.en: Focused on structured prompts, reusable parameters, and cross-model portability.

description.zh: Prompt Lab 帮助我验证了一个事实：创意工具的核心不是“功能多”，而是“反馈快”。
description.en: Prompt Lab validated one key idea for me: creative tooling wins with fast feedback loops, not feature overload.

design.zh: 以“卡片工作流”组织提示词版本，突出模板、参数和结果预览三段式操作路径。
design.en: Card-based workflow that emphasizes a three-step path: template, parameter, and result preview.

architecture.zh: Next.js 应用层 + 轻量状态管理 + 模板引擎，支持多模型输出格式映射。
architecture.en: Next.js app layer + lightweight state management + template engine for multi-model output mapping.

tagline.zh: 开发过程记录与复盘系统
tagline.en: Timeline log and review system for builders

summary.zh: 把“每天做了什么”变成可搜索、可分析、可复用的知识资产。
summary.en: Turn daily build progress into searchable, analyzable, reusable knowledge.

description.zh: 我正在把它做成一个产品化的“个人研发记忆系统”，支持从问题到决策再到结果的完整链路追踪。
description.en: I am shaping it into a productized personal R&D memory system with full traceability from issue to decision and outcome.

design.zh: 时间轴主视图 + 标签侧栏，突出“连续记录”和“决策上下文”的阅读体验。
design.en: Timeline-first view with tag sidebar, designed for continuity of logs and decision context.

architecture.zh: 内容层（日志）+ 索引层（标签/日期）+ 检索层（全文搜索）三层结构。
architecture.en: Three-layer architecture: content logs, indexing by tags/date, and full-text retrieval.

tagline.zh: 面向 AI 时代的 API 调试台
tagline.en: API debugging workbench for AI-era products

summary.zh: 支持 HTTP / GraphQL / WebSocket，一套工作流覆盖调试到文档导出。
summary.en: Covers HTTP, GraphQL, and WebSocket with one flow from debugging to docs export.

description.zh: 计划把 API 调试和团队协作结合，形成“可共享、可审计”的接口实验空间。
description.en: Planned as a collaborative and auditable API lab for teams.

design.zh: 双栏请求-响应布局，配合环境变量和历史快照，强调可追溯性。
design.en: Dual-pane request-response layout with env variables and snapshots for stronger traceability.

architecture.zh: 请求编排层 + 执行层 + 历史与导出层，支持多协议统一体验。
architecture.en: Request orchestration, execution, and history/export layers for a unified multi-protocol workflow.

tagline.zh: 开发者机会信号聚合器

summary.zh: 自动聚合产品反馈、社区需求和竞品更新，生成下一步行动建议。
summary.en: Aggregates product feedback, community demand, and competitor updates into actionable next steps.

description.zh: 这是我接下来最想推进的项目：把“做什么”从凭直觉，升级为数据驱动。
description.en: This is my next focus project: upgrade what-to-build decisions from intuition to signal-driven execution.

design.zh: 信号仪表盘 + 优先级矩阵视觉化，帮助快速判断下一步投入方向。
design.en: Signal dashboard with priority matrix visualization for rapid next-step decisions.

architecture.zh: 采集层（外部信号）+ 打分层（规则/模型）+ 决策层（优先级面板）。
architecture.en: Collection layer (external signals) + scoring layer (rules/models) + decision layer (priority board).
